# mms-interop fixtures

Copied unchanged from [otfabric/mms-interop](https://github.com/otfabric/mms-interop)
v0.4.0 (commit `5789893`), whose original files are MIT-licensed. The adapter
images that `tests/interop_mms_interop.rs` runs carry the same files, so the
two must be updated together.

| File | Upstream | Revision |
|---|---|---|
| `iec61850/interop.icd` | `fixtures/iec61850/interop.icd` | `iec61850-v3` |
| `iec61850/values.json` | `fixtures/iec61850/values.json` | `iec61850-v3` |
| `mms/interop.json` | `fixtures/mms/interop.json` | `mms-v2` |
